title: 10 Habits a Godly Man Drops With His Mom
caption:
Most guys are patient with their boss, kind to the barista, and short with their mom.

The one-word texts. The sigh when she asks the same thing twice. The eye roll at advice that turns out to be right. Home is where we drop the act, and too often it's where we drop the kindness too.

A godly man is hard on himself and gentle with others, and his mom is the first "others" on the list.

Pick one of these to drop this week. Then call her for no reason.

Save this. Send it to your brother.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #family #honor
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
